description: This file contains server-side logic for the MCQ Set management page of an online examination system. It includes event handlers for page load, course selection, question addition, exam setting, and navigation buttons. The code interacts with SQL database to insert and retrieve question and exam details, and dynamically populate course options based on semester selection.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQ question setup page, handling question and exam creation, course selection, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently commented out.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin panel.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Dynamically populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields for question and exam details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new question into the mcqQS table, updates question number, and shows a confirmation alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates or updates the exam detail in the mcqCourseDetail table and navigates to admin panel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles semester selection change, repopulating course dropdown accordingly.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Fetches and updates question number based on selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.
